rounds: Nursing is a job you can only do well if you see it as a calling.
Twelve-hour shifts are fine if you get more days off in return.
Nurses deserve to be paid as much as doctors.
In ten years, robots will be doing a lot of the work nurses do today.
Private hospitals make a public health service better, not worse.
Health care should be free for everyone, even if it means much higher taxes.
A few years working abroad is better training than any course at home.
Nurses and doctors should be allowed to strike, even if operations are cancelled.
